verdict.rationale: Sign-in method is a fair question for INPI Portugal, since it offers online filing and online title requests. However, the evidence pack never describes the authentication path: there is nothing on credential MFA, Chave Móvel Digital, citizen-card readers, biometrics, or mailed PINs. Mentions of an online filing guide and in-person appointment scheduling say nothing about whether an authorized human can complete remote credential MFA.
